### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **3** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, touching **30** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**37** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b`.

⛔ **7** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `packageId (4 routes)`
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `os validate (command, 87 pages)`
- **5** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **63** of **221** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **45** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `29087b212d64a1c407b916fdd174e0d59f50a9be` — the merge of head `435f30c7f5e18059de44fb0d3579aed79aff88f5` into base `badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 29087b212d64a1c407b916fdd174e0d59f50a9be && git checkout 29087b212d64a1c407b916fdd174e0d59f50a9be
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b 435f30c7f5e18059de44fb0d3579aed79aff88f5 && git checkout -B drift-repro badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b && git merge --no-ff 435f30c7f5e18059de44fb0d3579aed79aff88f5

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs badf24dffc27773f566987e810e36896bbd34c2b` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `435f30c7f5e18059de44fb0d3579aed79aff88f5`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.test.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-object-extension-item.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/index.ts, packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/extension-redeclared-owner-fields.ts, packages/cli/test/validate-extension-redeclared-owner-field.test.ts, packages/cli/test/validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts, packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-field-patch-targets.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-object-extension-item.test.ts + packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts (`BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST`), packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts (`FieldSchema`, a strict object with stamped defaults), packages/objectql/src/registry.ts (`mergeObjectDefinitions`, `getObjectOwner`, `reportRedeclaredFields`), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts (the `__c` judge and its wiring precedent), packages/cli/src/utils/field-patch-targets.ts and artifact-packages.ts (the validate walk), packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts, protocol-history-and-publish.ts and protocol-authoring-gate.ts (the three callers of `objectExtensionItemRefusal`), docs/adr/0146 D10, examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-sso-provider.object.ts (the measurement). Reviewed at `435f30c7`; the delta from the claimed `674555fc` is one test-only line (a raw `sys_metadata` seed drops `organization_id: null`), read.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The refused shape is D10's, and only D10's — right.** `judgeRedeclaredOwnerFields` refuses an `objectExtensions[].fields` key only when (a) the extended object has a known owner, (b) that owner is a different package from the extension's, (c) the owner's own declaration (`ownerFieldOf(owner.definition, name)`) carries the key, and (d) `redeclaredFieldChanges` is non-empty. Each of (a)–(c) defaults to "not judged", so an added field, an extension of the package's own object and an unknown owner are untouched; nothing else in the accept set moves.
2. **The whitelist is the ADR's constant, not a guessed list — right.** `FIELD_DISPLAY_KEYS` / `OPTION_DISPLAY_KEYS` are built from `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST.field` / `.option` imported from `@objectstack/spec/data` (`label`, `description`, `inlineHelpText`, `placeholder`; option `label`), and the prescription text is derived from the same constant. `packages/spec/**` is not touched.
3. **"Changes anything outside the whitelist" is read against the merge's real semantics — right.** `mergeObjectDefinitions` spreads `{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`, so a re-declaration replaces the owner's field whole; the judge therefore counts an omitted structural key (dropped `required`) as a change, compares `options` as membership keyed by stored `value` with option `label` removed (relabel/reorder = no change; added value = `options`), ignores `name` and the ADR-0010 `_` envelope, and reads both sides through `FieldSchema` first so a parse-stamped default (`required: false`, `hidden: false`, `sortable: true`, type-aware `unique`) is stamped on both sides. The dev's "display-only re-declaration is admitted" is therefore exactly "the served field is the owner's field with display keys changed".
4. **Three doors, one judge — right.** Publish/save/restore: step 7 of `objectExtensionItemRefusal`, whose three callers on `main` are `protocol-save.ts` :1204 (draft and live save), `protocol-history-and-publish.ts` :736 (per-item and package publish) and `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` :121 (restore); owner = `registry.getObjectOwner(target)` (the `own` contributor's declaration, never the resolved object, which already carries this package's earlier extension). `os validate`: step 3a-v-bis, walk mirrors `findFieldPatchTargetRefusals` (same `artifactPackages` + `declaredObjects` shape; `packages[]` under its own id, or the stack under `manifest.id`). Install: `install-local` step 2e' on both the managed branch and the `.custom` pair branch, before any write, with the same `UNRUNNABLE_REFUSAL_CODE`/`STATUS` (`VALIDATION_ERROR`/422) and `details.refusals` envelope step 2e uses; owner = delivered body first, then `registry.getObjectOwner`. Same judge, same `message`, same `changed` list at all three. An extension of an object outside the artifact is not judged at `os validate` (no owner known there) and is judged at install — declared in the PR and consistent with the field-patch precedent.
5. **A registry without `getObjectOwner` leaves step 7 unasked** (`registry?.getObjectOwner?.(target)`), the fail-open direction every other target check in that gate takes; the real `SchemaRegistry` has it (`registry.ts` :6623). Right.
6. **`reportRedeclaredFields` is unchanged** — `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` is not in the diff. Right.
7. **Nothing unrelated narrows.** `validate.ts` adds one step that exits 1 only on a non-empty refusal list; `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts` classifies the new gate under `VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` (so `os build` is explicitly unchanged); `index.ts` adds exports only. No door loses an accepted body other than the D10 shape.
8. **Claim "zero first-party re-declarations" — holds, re-measured on `origin/main`.** `examples/**` has one extension (`account.extension.ts`: `loyalty_tier`, `linkedin_url`, `csat_score`), none declared by `account.object.ts` (`showcase_account`), and it extends its own package's object; `plugin-auth` extends `sys_sso_provider` with `oidc_client_secret`, which `sys-sso-provider.object.ts` does not declare; HotCRM at `6961ab1` contains no `objectExtensions`. The narrowing reaches no first-party artifact.

### ② Semver level

`minor` for `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/cloud-connection` — the three packages whose doors narrow; `runtime` carries only a test. A breaking accept-set narrowing ships as `minor` under the pre-GA rule `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` states, marked `!` / **BREAKING** in the changeset. `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` are on the PR body and the changeset, first-of-line, matching the seat's amended claim (6670473941). The ADR-0087 marker `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` matches the measurement in ①.8 (no first-party user; no mechanical rewrite exists because which keys were meant as display is a judgement). Check Changeset: success on this head. Consistent.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev deviation 1 (`no` → `no (narrowing)`): the seat's amendment 6670473941 records it; the dogfood battery ran on `435f30c7`, as the arm requires. Answered.
- Dev deviation 2 (ADR-0087 `not-required`): consistent with ①.8; a registered entry would need `packages/spec`, which the claim forbids. Answered.
- Dev deviation 3 (tests in `packages/runtime` and `packages/cloud-connection`): added to the file surface by amendment 6670473941. Answered.
- Dev deviation 4 (no assignee / reviewer request): the seat's standing lines; not a contract matter.
- `open_questions`: none. `out_of_scope_findings`: `os build` does not run the check (`VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES` row) — the same gap the field-patch target row carries; the install door refuses what the build emits. Not a must-fix for this card (the card named `os validate`, publish and install); carrier none is acceptable, a follow-up card may close both rows together.
- PR author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no extra author note owed.
- Check-runs on `435f30c7` at review time: Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Dogfood Regression Gate, PR-body guards, PR Size, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · tooling self-tests: success; Build Core, Test Core shards, Type Check ×4, Lint ×6, Live E2E UI: in_progress. This record does not stand in for them: landing pre-check ② (all green) stays the seat's.
- Added by this review: none that blocks (see ④ should-fix notes).

### ④ Design judgment

- `protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts` against `mergeObjectDefinitions`, `FieldSchema` and D10: holds. The judge's definition of "change" is the one the fold makes real (whole replace), the whitelist is read not spelled, and the acceptance scenario (a module turning `amount: number` into `text`, dropping `required`, adding `readonly`/`defaultValue`/formula, adding an option value) is refused with `fieldPatches` and the whitelist named; a label/help/placeholder/option-label-only re-declaration is admitted. Tried to break it: (i) key present on the owner, absent on the extension → counted (correct, the fold would drop it); (ii) `options` reorder/relabel → no change, added/removed value or changed option `visibleWhen`/`color` → `options` (correct: membership and non-display option keys stay the vendor's); (iii) the array spelling of `fields` → located by index; (iv) owner declaration carrying `_packageId`/`_provenance` → stripped before parse. Pins: 12 unit cases, including each refusal and each admission; the dev's ablation (the `changed.length === 0` guard flipped to always continue) turned 6/6 refusal cases red and left admissions green, which is the right shape for a refusing judge.
- `protocol-object-extension-item.ts` step 7: holds. Order after the `__c` judge is right (a `.custom` pair's unsuffixed key gets the `__c` sentence first, which also names `fieldPatches`). The runtime rig pins the real registry: a type change is refused at save with `VALIDATION_ERROR`/400 at `fields.name` and no row, a pre-rule draft is refused at publish and stays a draft, a display-only re-declaration saves and publishes. Pins assert code + status + location + absence of a row/extender.
- `validate.ts` + `utils/extension-redeclared-owner-fields.ts`: holds. The walk is the field-patch walk's shape, the verdict is the shared judge, and `--json` carries `path`/`code`/`changed`. The integration test spawns the CLI on an assembled two-package artifact and asserts exit 1 + the located row + `changed: ['type']`, and exit 0 on relabel.
- `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 2e': holds on both branches; refuses before any write (test asserts no registration, no sync, empty dir). Owner resolution (delivered first, then installed) matches the field-patch target precedent and D10's "owner's own declaration" reading. The multi-package case pins `options` membership against an owner the same artifact delivers.
- `validate-build-gate-parity.test.ts`: the row is a truthful classification, not a widening.

Should-fix (non-blocking, none is a FAIL):
1. A display-only re-declaration through `fields` is admitted, but it still replaces the owner's field whole, so it bypasses the ADR-0029 D9.2a `tenantPatched` yield that `fieldPatches` honours, and still draws the registry warning. That is the card's scope ("when the entry changes anything outside the whitelist"), not a defect of this PR; a follow-up may decide whether D10's prescription should be "always `fieldPatches`" for an owner field.
2. Step 7 runs before the item's strict parse. An extension field carrying a key `FieldSchema` refuses fails `safeParse` on one side only, so its `changed` list may name stamped defaults (`required`, `hidden`, `sortable`...) before the schema's own sentence. The accept set is the same (the body is refused either way); only which sentence the author reads first differs. Skipping the judge when either side fails to parse would hand the schema gate the first word.
3. D10's text names `protocol-package-install.ts#installPackage` as the install door; on `main` neither the `__c` judge nor this one is wired there — `install-local` is the door in practice (the #28564 precedent), and a code package registered at boot (`registerApp`) stays with the warning, as the card scoped. Worth a one-line ADR errata when D10 is next opened.

**VERDICT: PASS**

Head-sha: 435f30c7f5e18059de44fb0d3579aed79aff88f5

- **Shape:** 12 files, +856/−3, across `packages/metadata-protocol` (the judge, its wiring into `objectExtensionItemRefusal`, one export, tests), `packages/cli` (`os validate`), `packages/cloud-connection` (install-local), `packages/runtime` (one door test), one changeset. That matches the claimed surface (claim 6670139047, amendments 6670237566 and 6670473941). Not governed.
- **Contract review:** PASS at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, record 6671933596 (claim 6671883625, superseding 6671822373 on the earlier head), no must-fix, reviewed at this head.
- **Premise, measured:** an `objectExtensions[].fields` key that names a field the extended object's owner declares replaces that field whole (`{ ...base.fields, ...extension.fields }`), so a different package could take over an owner field with only a registry warning. D10's refused shape: owner from `getObjectOwner`, a different package, a change outside `BASE_FIELD_DISPLAY_WHITELIST` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, not re-spelled).
- **Spot check (from the diff and the review):**
  - One judge, one message and one `changed` list at every door: save, publish and restore (step 7 of `objectExtensionItemRefusal`), `os validate`, and install-local on both the managed and the `.custom` pair branches; 422 before any write.
  - Display-only re-declaration, an added field, the extender's own object and an unknown owner are admitted (pinned).
  - Zero first-party re-declarations, re-measured by the reviewer on `origin/main` (app-showcase, plugin-auth, HotCRM 6961ab1).
  - The dev's ablation turned every refusal case red while admissions stayed green.
- **Gates:** every check-run on this head has concluded: 35 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure.
- **Accepted deviations:** the `os build` gap (VALIDATE_ONLY_GATES row) is acknowledged with no carrier. The review's three should-fix notes are accepted as non-blocking: (1) a display-only re-declaration through `fields` still bypasses the D9.2a `tenantPatched` yield that `fieldPatches` honours, which is card-scoped and left for a follow-up decision; (2) `changed` may list stamped defaults ahead of the schema's own sentence for a key `FieldSchema` refuses (message order only); (3) D10 names `installPackage` as the install door, while install-local is the door in practice, a one-line ADR erratum for when D10 is next opened.
- **Contract:** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, `Skills-docs: no move`, confirmed from the diff and the review.
